rationale: RD-2D Stack-D cross-stack port sub-phase LANDING — B17 PATH-B (framework-validated carry-forward + re-bank). Stage 2 charter § 4.3 Step 2.8 routes between PATH-A (add a per-sim mutmut target for reaction_diffusion_2d_stack_d's Taichi-DSL source + rework the runner; produce a real per-target kill-rate baseline) and PATH-B (framework-validated artifact + re-bank to the next per-sim implementation sub-phase). PATH-B chosen, matching the operator-routed lean. Grounds: (a) this sub-phase is a cross-stack PORT of an existing sim (reaction-diffusion-2d), not a new sim; the algorithm identity is shared with the Phase-0 Stack-B reference, whose correctness is already established. The load-bearing correctness evidence at HEAD is gate-4 (MMS observed OOA 1.9972 against formal 2.0), gate-10 (IC-13 content-equivalence via run_twice_and_diff), gate-11 (3 Hypothesis PBT invariants), gate-13 (failing-tests sha256 replay + worktree ModuleNotFoundError reproduction at ca9bc0b), and the Phase-2-specific gate-14 (cross-stack equivalence within_tolerance=True at relative=1e-4; max_abs_err 1.9e-14 with ~10 orders of margin). (b) The B17 'first real per-target kill-rate baseline' milestone is already DONE — landed PATH-A at continuous-CA-rd3d and continued through sph-water / eulerian-smoke / LBM / MPM (five real per-target baselines; empirical kill-rate range [0.4879, 0.5927]). Adding a per-sim mutmut target for the Taichi-DSL @ti.kernel source would require @ti.kernel × mutmut interaction characterization (Taichi lowers kernels at first call; mutmut source-hash invalidation against the Taichi AST transformer is uncharacterized) for marginal additional signal at the FIRST cross-stack pair. That characterization is its own infrastructure work, properly owned by a testing-improvements sub-phase, not folded into a per-sim cross-stack port. The mutation gate remains advisory (non-blocking) at sub-phase scope per § J.5. B17 per-sim-target work re-banked to the testing-improvements sub-phase (Taichi-DSL mutmut characterization) per § J.2.
